description: Stops every build in the workspace from reaching one outside service: one a build is waiting on, or one allowed before (also one allowed automatically). Builds then work without it. Only owners and admins can turn one down.

host.description: The service's web address, such as api.yourbookings.com (a pasted link works too).

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: decline_build_access
title: Turn a service down for builds
